def count_vowels(s):
>>>>>>> origin/2026
    # Define vowels
    vowels = set('aeiou')
    counts = {}
    
    # Iterate through string characters
    for char in s.lower():
        if char in vowels:
            if char in counts:
                counts[char] += 1
            else:
                counts[char] = 1
    
    return counts

>>>>>>> origin/2026
    # Initialize counter
    count = 0
    
    # Iterate through dictionary keys
    for key in d.keys():
        # Convert key to string and check first character
        if str(key).startswith(char):
            count += 1
    
    return count
